data.one_liner: A simple tag editor widget designed to act and feel similar to the standard Material TextField.
data.what_it_does: Allows users to input tags dynamically using a Material-styled text field with delimiters. It supports custom chip builders and exposes properties like controllers, focus nodes, and input formatters.
use_when: You need a Material-style tag input or chip entry field in your form.
You want to split tags automatically using delimiters like spaces or commas.
avoid_when: You need a complex multi-select dropdown that is not tag-based.
You are using a non-Material design system.
strengths: Feels similar to the standard Material TextField.
Supports custom tag builders (e.g., using Chip).
Exposes useful properties like TextEditingController and FocusNode.
weaknesses: No documentation on topics or advanced use cases beyond basic setup.
